name: Release release-1.15.0
body:
### General changes/additions

* fa.c: set an error when parse_regexp() fails without setting a specific one, instead of returning NULL with the status left at       REG_NOERROR, which callers read as success  (addresses CVE-2025-2588) (#854) Alexander Bokovoy
* Cast to 'unsigned char' before calling ctype functions like isspace()  and toupper(), which is undefined behavior for negative char values,  e.g. for a non-ASCII byte in a path expression or a lens file name   (#886) rootvector2
* Fix aug_preview(), which failed with "Lens not found" whenever spans  were enabled; it now finds the file node by walking up from the  matched node rather than by looking the path up again (#899)`  George Hansper
* Make ATTRIBUTE_FALLTHROUGH work on clang as well as gcc (#836)   Richard Barnes
* Fix gcc 14 warnings, notably the transposed reallocarray() arguments  in augprint.c (#842) rwmjones
* Miscellaneous gcc 16 fixes, mostly const-correctness now that gcc 16  passes the constness of the argument through strchr() and friends    (#881) rwmjones
* Fix some compiler warnings in lens.c, augmatch.c (#818) George Hansper
* src/Makefile.am: fix a race when building liblexer_la-lexer.lo  Andrew Kovac
* gnulib: fetch the submodule over https; git.savannah.gnu.org no   longer serves the unauthenticated git:// protocol, so a fresh clone   could not initialize .gnulib
* build: set DISTCHECK_CONFIGURE_FLAGS so 'make distcheck' does not   build gnulib's own test suite, which tests gnulib against the local   libc rather than testing augeas
* build: man/Makefile.am listed the files to distribute with a wildcard   over the source directory and never cleaned the man pages it   generates, so what a release tarball contained depended on the state   of the tree it was built from, and 'make distcheck' failed from a    clean checkout. The pages are now listed explicitly, built at dist    time and shipped - building from a tarball no longer needs pod2man
* tests: cover aug_preview() with spans enabled, the case #899 fixed      (#859) Alexis Mousset
* tests: add tests around embedded quotes to      tests/test-augtool/quoted-strings.sh (#826) George Hansper
* tests: ignore 'nobody' groups in test-preserve.sh so the suite passes     in an unprivileged namespace (#858) Patrycja
* tests: use AM_CPPFLAGS rather than the obsolete INCLUDES
* ci: get the build workflow running again; it pinned ubuntu-20.04, a      runner image GitHub has retired, so every run failed before it started
* ci: fix the release workflow, which used '::set-output' and two      actions GitHub has archived, and so could not have produced a release
* ci: populate the .gnulib submodule from an actions cache, or with a      shallow fetch of the pinned revision, so that bootstrap does not      clone all of gnulib's history on every run
* Remove the Travis configuration; CI moved to GitHub Actions in 1.13.0      and travis-ci.org has since shut down
* README: point the build badge at GitHub Actions rather than the      shut-down travis-ci.org, and the fuzzing badge at issues.oss-fuzz.com

### Lens changes/additions

* Aptsources: parse all the option types apt allows, not just arch=    and trusted= (#865) Sunil Mohan Adapa
* Aptsources822: new lens for Deb822 style apt sources, which use the    .sources extension; Aptsources is limited to *.list (#801)
      James Valleroy
* Aptsources822: add the Snapshot field, make a multi-line Signed-By  readable, allow the file to be created (#896) George Hansper
* Chrony: add support for leapseclist (#843) Cosmin Tupangiu
* Crypttab: support the link-volume-key option used by systemd v256    (#880) rwmjones
* Fstab: allow a comma after the last option (#838) Cosmin Tupangiu
* IPRoute2: also read /usr/share/iproute2, the fallback directory   iproute2 6.5.0 added for stateless configuration, and exclude the    README files that explain it (#875) Tim Wiederhake, (#902)    George Hansper
* Iptables: support the ipset module's --match-set (#861) Will Harvey
* Iptables: more consistent naming, fix the failing tests (#897)      George Hansper
* Multipath: support all possible values for find_multipaths (#835)     rwmjones
* Nginx: include /etc/nginx/snippets (#864) Mark C.
* Ntp: parse 'tos minclock', and add /etc/ntpsec/ntp.conf to the filter     (#821) François-Régis Degott
* Pg_Hba, Postgresql, Rsyslog: add the /usr/local paths that source      installations use (#888) Showta Ishizaki
* Simplevars: read the subdirectories of /etc/zabbix (#815) smgrol
* Simplevars: fix the path of OpenBSD's wsconsctl.conf, which has read      /etc/wsconsctlctl.conf since it was added and so never matched      anything (#887) Showta Ishizaki
* Simplevars: take over /etc/adduser.conf from Shellvars; of the     systems that ship the file only FreeBSD treats it as a shell script,      and the perl that OpenBSD's and Debian's adduser(8) write either      fails to parse or silently vanishes from the tree (#893)      Showta Ishizaki
* Systemd: allow the '+' (fullprivileges) command flag (#841)      Cosmin Tupangiu
* Tmpfiles: permit the '$' type modifier in /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/*.conf      (#850) rwmjones
